explanation: The article's § Implementation makes the operation's camps the thing the invasion of Zaire was launched against: "These camps contained the Rwandan state military (FAR) which led to the invasion of Zaire by Rwanda, Burundi and Uganda, known as the First Congo War." It is precondition-of rather than caused because the article gives the camps' composition, not the operation itself, as what led to the invasion — the operation is what put them there. The atlas already holds 1994-genocide-against-tutsi --precondition-of--> first-congo-war; this is the same chain read through the French operation the article says created the camps.
